Name: SHIE'S PORTRAITS
Author: Shielia
Description:
I am Japanese. My English is an automatic translation. Please forgive me if you find it strange. 
This portrait is high resolution only. "Portraiture" and "PortraiturePlus" is required.
Please download it from here.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]

[color=#e06666]UPDATE (2025/11/13)[/color]
Option File : SVE 


[b]How To install :[/b]
1. Unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url] and place them in the mods folder.
2.Unzip this mod and place it in Mods > Portraiture > Portraits.
3.Start the game, talk to someone, press "P" to change, and press "O" to save.

[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=5]♡
[/size][/color][/b]Thank you to everyone who likes my art.You're welcome to paint new portraits in my art style. It would be a great honor.
However, please remember to credit me and follow the rules of other mods if you reference them.
